title: Held Since the Beginning
story:
A grandmother opened an old photo album with her grandson.

They smiled as they looked through the pictures.

There was his first smile.

His first birthday.

His first day at school.

Every page told another story.

The boy asked,

“Were you there for all of this?”

His grandmother laughed.

“For as much as I could be.”

Then she added,

“But Someone was with you even before any of these pictures were taken.”

She pointed toward the sky.

“God knew you before you were born.

He watched over your very first breath.

And He has never stopped caring for you.”

The boy looked at the album once more.

He realized that every memory was part of a much greater story—God's faithful care throughout his life.

In the same way, whether we are young or old, we can trust that the God who carried us from the beginning will never stop holding us.
life_lesson: The God who cared for you from your first breath will remain faithful throughout your entire life.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for watching over me from the very beginning of my life.

Thank You for Your constant care through every season.

Help me to trust You with my future, knowing that the One who has carried me this far will never leave me.

May my life always bring You praise.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Can you see God's faithfulness in different seasons of your life?

How does remembering His past care strengthen your trust for the future?

What can you thank Him for today?
